rationale: The assistant correctly prioritised isolating power at the consumer unit from a dry spot and told her to leave the machine alone, and it had her get out of the water. It never mentioned turning off the water supply, did not suggest an electrician check the socket, and gave no guidance on the likely front leak or door seal. The first reply also listed speculative causes such as a pump seal or cracked tub, and it told her to turn off the machine at its controls while she was near the water. The advice was safe but thin, and the closing step was vague.
